items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
OBSERVED CONTROLS: WASD moves (short taps ~0.3-0.5s move little, ~1-1.5s holds move farther; movement feels slow, camera scrolls with character). Space = 'Do Action' (contextual harvest/interact; only works when target is in range and not occluded). LMB on world objects only selects/examines. Escape opens Paused menu (Continue, Controls, Settings, Save, Quit). Controls menu listed: Primary LMB, Secondary RMB, Force Inspect Left Alt, Force Attack Left Ctrl, Do Attack F, Do Action Space, Move W/S/A/D; no craft key shown. Tab toggles map. Picked items appear in bottom inventory slots after ~1s animation. Ground drops (twigs, sticks) auto-collect when walked over. CRAFTING UI: left sidebar category icons (axe ~y0.13, flame 'Light' ~y0.185, plus trap/yarn/sword/cup/survival lower). Clicking an icon selects the category and expands a column of recipe tiles at x~0.117. Hovering a recipe tile reveals a detail panel with exact costs and a Build button (greyed when unaffordable); clicking a tile did NOT visibly craft anything and gave no feedback. Campfire recipe observed: 3 cut grass + 2 logs. HOVER VERBS: hovering a target shows 'Pick Flower/Sapling/Grass' when in range, 'Examine X' when out of range/occluded; labels sometimes fail to appear even when close (finicky aim, may need precise tuft pixels). Pick range is tight and seems asymmetric: a tuft ~90px up-screen gave 'Pick', horizontal ~70-120px often gave only 'Examine'; standing directly on/overlapping a tuft yielded 'Examine' and Space did nothing (may block interaction). Reliable successful pattern: approach open-sided target, verify 'Pick' verb, then Space. RESOURCE YIELDS: white flowers and red flowers -> petals (stacked to x2); spiky/bare saplings and grass tufts -> grass and twigs; saplings often leave a twig/stick ground drop to walk over. Grass tufts frequently sit at pine-tree bases where trunks occlude them; must aim at tuft pixels and approach from the open side. Character can be hidden behind tree trunks. DARKNESS: screen dims to full darkness with starry vignette at night; in darkness the character takes repeated hits ('OW! Something hit me!', 'What was that?!') and total darkness previously ended a run (death). FAILED STRATEGIES: click-to-harvest; Space from too far/through a trunk; expecting recipe tooltips without hovering (hover, not click, shows costs); expecting a tile click to craft; spamming category clicks; wasting daylight on UI debugging; trying tufts at trunk bases without repositioning; standing on top of a tuft (yields Examine). UNRESOLVED HYPOTHESES (guesses, unconfirmed): dark recipe silhouettes = insufficient ingredients/locked; some Light recipe (possibly torch) is cheaper than campfire (maybe grass+twigs) and was not yet read; top Light tile's cost never displayed; bottom-right scroll/document icon (~0.93,0.89) unexplored; craft activation may require selecting a recipe then Space or clicking Build. LESSONS FOR NEXT RUN: gather grass and twigs (and logs if an axe is acquired) in quantity early; read recipe costs by hovering before judging affordability; resolve craft activation and build fire well before dusk; never stay in total darkness; verify proximity via hover verb before Space; approach trunk-base tufts from the open side and step back if overlapped; avoid repeating UI actions that showed no response.
